title: Climate reading
description: Published on noise/<site>/<node_id>/climate after a DHT read (successful or not).

node_id.description: NODE_ID of the node; also the third level of the topic.

session_id.description: Scheduled session start in UTC, YYYYMMDDTHHMMSSZ.

t_offset_ms.description: Time of the reading in ms since session start (node monotonic clock).

temp_c.description: Temperature in °C; null if the read failed.

rh.description: Relative humidity in %; null if the read failed.

error.description: Last error when the read failed; null on success.
